# Service

I provide services broadly in data science, R programming, and ecological data analysis. If you're interested in any of these, please feel free to [contact me](../about.qmd).


## Bioacoustics data analysis 🐦

I specialize in bioacoustics data analysis, particularly for datasets collected with autonomous recording units (ARUs). I can help take your workflow from raw audio files to clean detection tables, set up structured detection validation, and prepare your data for downstream analyses—such as acoustic embedding analysis or occupancy modelling—tailored to your research questions.


## Bioacoustics & data science workshops 🏫

I offer hands-on bioacoustics workshops tailored for ecologists, covering audio data processing in R as well as running and validating BirdNET workflows (both in R and via the GUI). I also lead general data science workshops on data wrangling with `tidyverse`, data visualization with `ggplot2`, ecological modelling in R, data management, Git & GitHub, reproducible coding, and R package development.


## Data pipelines & management 🎓

I specialize in preparing and streamlining data pipelines for complex, large-scale datasets, especially ecological data such as audio, video, and imagery. My services include data cleaning, wrangling, automated analysis, and advanced ecological modelling — components that can be part of a scientific manuscript. I also help put organizational datasets in order and set up GitHub organization pages, so your team can manage and share data long after the project ends.


## R package development 📦

Building R packages is one of the best ways to make code accessible and reusable — whether as an internal tool for your team, or an open-source solution for the broader research community. I offer package development from scratch, as well as improving or co-developing existing packages.


## Shiny tools, quarto & R markdown 📊

R Markdown and Quarto are powerful tools for turning data into clear, well-organized reports, while Shiny tools and Quarto dashboards make that data interactive — letting stakeholders explore and engage with results directly. I build documentation, dashboards, and interactive Shiny tools to help your team communicate data more clearly and make it easier for others to engage with. BTW, this website was created by Quarto!
